title: Barefoot Bliss | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Barefoot Bliss — a house in Dune Allen, Florida. 14 guests · 6 bedrooms · 7 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Barefoot Bliss,' where elegant design meets exquisite Gulf-front location! Located in a highly sought-after Dune Allen Beach community, Barefoot Bliss is a 6-bedroom, 7-bathroom luxury home that sleeps 14 comfortably. With stunning emerald water views from the private pool and direct access to the beach, this home perfectly embodies 30A living!The ground level of this home offers on-site parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway, as well as the convenience of a bathroom and laundry room. Additionally, the laundry room has one set of twin over twin bunk beds.Upon entering this 4-story residence, guests will find a bright great room, aglow with sunshine from the stunning Gulf-front views. An inviting living area offers plush seating around a 75” TV, while a nearby sitting room provides additional comforts with a queen sleeper sofa—ideal for last-minute visitors. Guests can easily prepare cocktails with a wine fridge and ice maker at the wet bar before sitting at the 10-seat dining table for a home-cooked meal. The pristine white kitchen, featuring a stunning marble island with a built-in sink, is fully equipped with high-end Thermador appliances, making it easy to host large groups. Enjoy access to the spacious outdoor deck from anywhere in the great room—swim in the private pool with a built-in sitting spa, relax on 4 cozy loungers, or grill up some snacks in the outdoor kitchen.Guests can use the stairs or in-home elevator to access the top floors of this home. The third floor offers 3 stylish guest bedrooms with great views, each boasting access to a rear balcony overlooking the pool. Just down the hallway is a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as a stacked washer and dryer for convenience.The fourth floor offers similar accommodations—a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as another closet with a stacked washer and dryer. There are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms with access to a rear balcony overlooking beautiful Gulf waters. Both the third and fourth floor wet bars are stocked with a Keurig machine for the early risers!This beachfront property provides incredible amenities and spectacular views, as well as being a prime location for exploring local shops and restaurants. With 8 adult bikes—plus a 6-passenger golf cart—getting around has never been easier. Experience the ultimate relaxation and convenience at Barefoot Bliss!HOME HIGHLIGHTSSteps from the beachGulf front with spectacular viewsPrivate pool with Sitting Spa Pool heating available for $50 per dayComplimentary beach setups each morning include 8 beach chairs with 4 umbrellas6 Passenger golf cart8 adult bikesElevatorCrib and highchair providedOne step from the sand from back doorPARKINGFour driveway parking spaces available. No garage access.Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 8 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost.ACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 14FIRST FLOORBedroom #1: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOORBedroom/Living Combo: Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOORBedroom #2: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyBedroom #3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboBedroom #4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyFOURTH FLOORBedroom #5: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateBedroom #6: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed Linens |WELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterHOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*Private Heated Pool With Spa **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Pool & spa are heated together. Must be heated for duration of stay. If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app.Please note, the garage is not for guest use.Other things to note
